name: NEON FISSION
title: Neon Fission
blurb: Load cells with orbs until they burst and take their neighbours. Last one with cells wins.
description: Add an orb a turn. A full cell bursts into its neighbours and takes them, and bursts chain across the grid. Last player with cells wins. 2 to 8 players, bots or friends, on one phone or many.
author: lokeshmohanty
